name: Permafrost
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Issuaq Adaptics: Sustaining Diversity, Parhelion's Jinteki identity, which earns a power counter for each agenda scored that was not installed or advanced that turn, and needs a point less to win for each. A Thousand Cuts' frame under a new identity, with two Seamless Launch for its two Mindscaping: placing counters is not advancing, so an agenda installed on an earlier turn and launched over its requirement is scored the Issuaq way (Parhelion Stage 7). Parhelion Stage 8: two Hafrún for two Lionsmane, ice for ice. Midnight Sun Stage 7b: two Mitosis for its two Seamless Launch, an operation that advances for one that advances, two new remotes with two counters each that its traps make the Runner check; Brutal Efficiency and The Syndicate keep Seamless Launch. Downfall Stage 3: two Storgotic Resonator for two Front Company, a power counter the first time each turn the Corp trashes a card of the Runner's faction, spent for net damage. Reprints Stage 2: two Hokusai Grid for its two The Red Room and two Embolus for its two Tributary; both are still in Open Book.
